root_cause_label: Objective Misread (Max-Achievable Instead of Guaranteed Minimax)
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent misinterprets 'regardless of departure times' as finding the maximum achievable gap over all offset configurations rather than the guaranteed minimax gap, locking in the wrong objective at step 1 and never correcting it despite awareness at step 9.
t_err_evidence: solve_mathematical() hardcodes 219 and maximizes gap over offsets instead of computing the worst-case guarantee
t_commit_evidence: At step 1 the wrong objective is encoded into all solution paths (solve_mathematical, solve_efficiently, main's max combiner); the agent's actual subsequent behavior (steps 2-11) never corrects the objective, consistently computing and accepting the max-over-offsets answer of 99.
t_surface_evidence: Mathematical solution: 219 days ... Maximum gap found: 99
trigger_explanation: The problem statement's key qualifier 'regardless of when each company starts' specifies a worst-case guarantee (minimax: for every offset configuration the gap is at least d). The agent dropped this requirement and instead solved the easier problem of finding the best-case maximum achievable gap (max over offsets), writing code that takes max() across results rather than min().
